subject: HumDial-FDBench

upstream.paper_title: Full-Duplex Interaction in Spoken Dialogue Systems: A Comprehensive Study from the ICASSP 2026 HumDial Challenge

f2_interpretation.why_useful: The scenario taxonomy directly exercises F2 invariants that WER/TTS-only tests miss: barge-in, stop, backchannel rejection, pause patience, third-party rejection, overlap and response delay.
f2_interpretation.why_not_acceptance: No German F2 target run, no F2 VoiceIntent/GWT/UnifiedDB/effect integration run, and no proof that the released corpus matches the target user's language/acoustics.
f2_interpretation.recommended_adaptation: Translate/adapt the nine interaction scenarios into pinned German two-channel fixtures while preserving the original event labels, then add F2-specific checks for cancellation correctness, unheard-output non-commit, VoiceOutcome causal re-entry and Presence/Interruptibility state transitions.

next_exact_gate: Trigger4 benchmark-harness lane: implement a bounded German adaptation of the nine HumDial-FDBench interaction scenarios against the existing F2 voice ABI and score interruption/rejection/delay plus F2 cancellation and causal-reentry correctness; do not use the upstream leaderboard as F2 acceptance evidence.
